Home / Services / Precious metals refining
10 / REFINING

From metal-bearing input to a defined output.

Refining refers to processes used to separate, recover or improve the purity of metals. The most relevant route depends on the incoming material, its composition, impurities and the intended output. Use this service area to discuss a potential refining requirement and the technical information needed to assess it.

THE SERVICE IN CONTEXT

A defined scope leads to a better decision.

Learn how feedstock characterization, recovery options and product specification shape refining discussions.

The suitable approach depends on the material, the intended outcome and the details agreed by the parties.

Make a service enquiry ↗
A CLOSER LOOK

What deserves attention.

Different specimen forms and questions call for different considerations. The following themes help frame the discussion.

01

Assessing the feedstock

The material may arrive as doré, alloy, scrap, concentrated intermediate product or another metal-bearing form. Composition and likely contaminants determine which process questions matter before any refining decision is made.

02

Understanding process routes

Industry refining approaches can involve thermal, electrochemical or wet-chemical methods, often combined in stages. Their suitability depends on the metals present and the desired recovery or specification. No particular plant, throughput or achievable purity is implied by this overview.

03

Yield, reconciliation and documentation

Material balance, loss accounting, recovery basis, output form and the treatment of residues can all affect a commercial refining agreement. Parties should discuss testing, ownership, processing terms and delivery arrangements before work begins.

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

What to prepare.

A few useful details can make your first enquiry much more focused.

  • Material type and approximate quantity
  • Previous assay or compositional data
  • Known contaminants or handling restrictions
  • Target product or required specification
  • Ownership, documentation and desired next step
Explore preparation guides ↗
COMMON QUESTIONS

A little more clarity.

Does refining mean all impurities can be removed?+
Each refining route has technical and commercial limits; achievable output specifications require assessment.
Can I receive a confirmed recovery quote online?+
No. Processing terms and feasibility depend on verified material details and a separately agreed proposal.
